evidence.content: Hi Skyler, I’m preparing the support rota for the upcoming launch starting June 3 (4 weeks, 09:00-17:00 UTC) covering North America and Europe. The work packet lists Ari and Bo as supporters. Do you have any information about additional available staff, their region expertise, or constraints I should consider to optimize coverage? Also, are Morgan, Robin, or Reese expected to be on the rota?
The Europe customer-success lead knows that most European customers need support after 16:00 UTC during the first launch week.
